market_summary: All symbols are consolidating during the London Session with sub-1.0 RVOL across the board. XAUUSD and BTCUSD display structural downtrends below their respective Value Areas and VWAPs, but are currently sitting at or near key lower support levels lacking breakout volume. EURUSD, GBPUSD, and US100 remain range-bound within their respective Value Areas chopping around POC and session VWAPs. Complete lack of volume expansion warrants a unified HOLD discipline across all 5 assets.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (3963.84) and below POC (3978.28), confirming clear Value Area acceptance lower. CVD is BEARISH at -3.27 with flat slope, agreeing with the prevailing downward structure. Market session is LONDON_SESSION. Price trades below both VWAP (3970.67) and EMA50 (3966.70). Currently positioned mid-channel after a bounce from Session Low (3924.30), but RVOL is low at 0.593 with no fresh yellow volume spike. S/R resistance at 3968.55 caps the upside while Session Low remains target. GEX is null outside NY cash session. Low momentum bounce warrants HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below declining VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10779 to VAH 1.10998) and below POC (1.10943), favoring mean reversion. CVD is NEUTRAL at +3,376 with a negative slope (-1733.97). Current session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is hovering directly around VWAP (1.10862) and EMA50 (1.10897) in tight consolidation. Mid-channel ATR positioning with low volume (RVOL 0.757, no spikes). Resistance at Session High (1.11027) held cleanly. GEX is null. Lack of directional edge inside the Value Area mandates HOLD.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32599 to VAH 1.32797) and below POC (1.32738). CVD is BEARISH at -3,991 with an accelerating negative slope (-2520.54), aligning with bearish pressure. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is holding below VWAP (1.32671) and EMA50 (1.32701) following a clear intraday rejection. ATR position is mid-channel testing local S/R at 1.32661. RVOL is 0.588 without yellow spike confirmation. GEX is null. Given price is compressed right on S/R support inside the Value Area, edge is insufficient; HOLD.

Price is inside Value Area (VAL 28086.57 to VAH 28185.57) right at POC (28121.92). CVD is BEARISH at -3.53 with negative slope (-1.47), agreeing with downward movement. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is trading below VWAP (28132.56) and EMA50 (28162.39). Price is consolidating mid-channel between EMA20 and lower ATR band. RVOL is 0.831 (standard for US100 CFD tick volume). Near local S/R at 28100.36. GEX is null. Because price sits directly on POC magnet with no clear directional expansion, HOLD is prudent.

Price is below VAL (73358.62) and below POC (73522.35), showing sustained value rejection. CVD is BEARISH at -0.05 with negative slope, concurring with downward momentum. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price trades well below both VWAP (73589.15) and EMA50 (73566.28). Candle is pushing near the lower ATR band (73075.90) directly into critical Session Low (73166.0) and Prev Low (73097.30) support without yellow RVOL confirmation (RVOL 0.812). Selling directly into major multi-touch support without an active impulse spike creates trap risk. HOLD.
